stunt-kite.context: A swept-back delta wing kite with two control lines running to small handles. Used for sport kite flying, kite festivals, beach activities and outdoor hobby pages.

relationship-chart.context: A square grid table with shaded cells along the diagonal. Used to work out how two relatives are related, such as cousins and removed cousins.
